extension.summary: Void - one thing at a time.
extension.description: The quietest possible media centre. One item in large type on true black; the longer you rest on it, the more it tells you, until the artwork slowly rises behind the text. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.10 - Settings: choose which main menu items to show. Home: up to three custom rows from any add-on, playlist or favourite.
